title: 36-Layer DBR with Relaxed Bounds and Projection Operator
scientific_hypothesis: Relaxing thickness bounds from [20,350]nm to [15,355]nm with a hard projection operator will eliminate compilation failures while maintaining or improving the 0.8996 target score achieved in iteration_05, as the additional 5nm margin accommodates optimizer drift without violating physical constraints.
design_principle: Quarter-wave DBR stack centered at 355nm for UV stopband, with optimized thickness perturbations to create secondary stopband at 1030-1080nm while preserving 420-700nm passband transmission.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
design_variables: all 36 layer thicknesses continuous in [15, 355] nm
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds relaxed to [15,355]nm per fallback protocol
projection operator clamps optimizer output before TMM evaluation
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
known_risks: Relaxed bounds may reduce fabrication tolerance
Score may not exceed 0.8996 historical best
execution_request_english: Design a 36-layer planar dielectric filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees unpolarized illumination. Stack topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | ... alternating for 18 pairs (36 finite layers total) | Fused Silica. Materials: Ta2O5 (high index) and SiO2 (low index). Optimize all 36 layer thicknesses as continuous variables bounded in [15, 355] nm. Implement hard projection operator that clamps any optimizer-proposed thickness to this range before TMM evaluation. Add matrix condition number diagnostic: if cond(M) > 1e10 during TMM solve, halt scoring and return warning. Objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 420-700nm band, minimize mean transmittance at 355nm single wavelength, minimize mean transmittance in 355-365nm band, minimize mean transmittance in 1030-1080nm band. Spectral grid: 1nm spacing from 350-1100nm. Initialize with quarter-wave thicknesses at 355nm (Ta2O5: ~62nm, SiO2: ~95nm) with 10% random perturbation. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with 500 iterations maximum. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Iteration_22 failed compilation due to initial thickness outside [20,350]nm bounds. This route implements the feedback directive to relax bounds to [15,355]nm with projection operator and condition number diagnostic.
